name: Broken Chalice Farm

description: Broken Chalice Farm is an on-farm market in 5615 FM 279, TX, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
